name: devpub
desc: Write in your editor. Publish to Dev.to. Track what works. A CLI tool for Dev.to with analytics, semantic search, and content discovery.

name: aws-lean-mcp
desc: A read-only AWS cost-triage MCP server, shipped bloated (15 tools) and lean (4 tools), to demonstrate MCP tool design and cut token cost. Same account, same question: 7 tool calls down to 2.

name: aws-auditor-agent
desc: A read-only AI agent that audits a live AWS account for security risks and wasted spend. One JSON config + one skill checklist for Kiro Crew / Amazon Q Developer CLI. It cites real resources, computes real costs, and physically cannot change anything.

name: dog-court
desc: 🏛️ Your dog committed a crime. AI gives them a fair trial. Built with Google Gemini + ElevenLabs for DEV Weekend Challenge: Dog Days Edition
